title: Influence under lifted odd majority
statement: For every natural number $m$, the total influence of odd majority on $2m+1$ coordinates is equal to the total influence of the function on $2m+2$ coordinates obtained by applying odd majority to the last $2m+1$ coordinates and ignoring the first coordinate.
